summary: Hitting a mob with a golden sword launches it into the sky with a burst of particles, with a 3 second cooldown per player.
behavior: When a player hits a living entity while holding a golden sword, launch the entity straight up (upward velocity of at least 1.2 blocks per tick).
Spawn cloud particles and play a firework launch sound at the entity when it is launched.
Each player has a 3 second cooldown between launches; hits during the cooldown deal normal damage only.
Any other item behaves like vanilla.

testPlan.summary: Hitting a mob with a golden sword launches it into the sky with a burst of particles, with a 3 second cooldown per player.

checks.title: A golden sword hit launches the mob upward
checks.steps: Equip golden_sword and attack the nearest husk once with trackTicks 20.
checks.expect: The husk's maxUpwardVelocity is above 0.8 blocks/tick within 5 ticks of the hit.

checks.title: A second hit within 3 seconds does not launch
checks.steps: Within 1 second of the first launch, summon another husk 2 blocks in front of the bot and hit it with the golden sword (trackTicks 20).
checks.expect: The second husk's maxUpwardVelocity stays below 0.5 blocks/tick.

checks.title: Other items behave like vanilla
checks.steps: Wait 4 seconds, summon a husk, equip iron_sword and hit it (trackTicks 20).
checks.expect: The husk's maxUpwardVelocity stays below 0.5 blocks/tick.
